doc.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025

title: Clefs for viola and cello
summary: Gold says alto and tenor clefs pose no trouble.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: By the way do you have trouble with alto clef with the viola?
No. Not anymore. Maybe when I was like 13 or 12. No. And also, you know the cello uses musical clefs. You know that.
There's that tenor clef that we use which isn't quite the viola clef but so I was — I understood that even when I was little.
